summary: A six-lane drum tracker and ROM-based drum workstation, the drum-focused fork of BEETLE, with song chains and a live setlist mode.
features: Six lanes and 48 patterns; each lane 1 to 16 steps long
Two built-in kits: BEETLE PCM samples and MONOLITH procedural sounds
Per-step FX, punch-in FX, ratchets, groove, mute groups and mixer
Song Mode chains up to 64; Live Mode setlist of 24 positions
12 project slots, 12 user kits and 13 user sample slots
USB audio capture as stereo or six mono stems

headings: editing and storing global user kits
patterns, step fx and song mode
switching firmware and returning to m-vave stock
